config_description: Validates, resolves and queries the JGates configuration.
config_unknown_action_fix: Use: jgates config validate | resolve [--profile <id>] [--explain] | get <pointer> [--profile <id>] [--cwd <project>] [--json]
config_unexpected_argument_fix: Use: jgates config validate | resolve [--profile <id>] [--explain] | get <pointer> [--profile <id>] [--cwd <project>] [--json]
config_bad_cwd: The project folder does not exist or is not a folder: {path}
config_yaml_too_large: The file has {size} bytes and the limit is {limit} bytes.
config_yaml_too_deep: The YAML nests deeper than the limit of {limit} levels.
config_yaml_alias_limit: The YAML uses too many aliases (limit of {limit}); the expansion was refused.
config_yaml_tag_forbidden: YAML tag not allowed (JGates neither runs nor resolves tags): {detail}
config_document_not_mapping: The document must be a map of keys and values.
config_enum: The value must be one of: {allowed}.
config_type: Invalid type; expected: {expected}. To switch something off use enabled: false, not null.
config_key_name: The name '{name}' is not valid here.
config_root_missing: The file jgates.yml does not exist in the project folder.
config_ref_outside_project: The reference '{ref}' points outside the project.
config_ref_missing_file: The referenced file '{ref}' does not exist.
config_unknown_fragment: The file '{ref}' is not a known fragment (workspace, tools, policy, profiles, architecture or pii).
config_ref_layer_unknown: The layer '{id}' does not exist in architecture.layers.
config_ref_component_unknown: The component '{id}' does not exist in the workspace.
config_ref_tool_unknown: The tool '{id}' does not exist in tools.
config_option_profile: Profile of this call (overrides selection.profile of jgates.yml).
config_option_explain: Shows the origin of each value: layer, file, path in the file and previous value.
config_option_not_supported: The option --{name} does not apply to config {action}.
config_option_not_supported_fix: Remove --{name} or use a subcommand that accepts it (resolve, get).
config_get_pointer_required: The pointer of the value is missing (for example /selection/profile).
config_get_bad_pointer: Invalid pointer: {pointer}. A pointer starts with / (JSON Pointer).
config_get_not_found_fix: Run jgates config resolve --explain --json to see the existing pointers.
config_get_not_found_suggest: No effective value at {pointer}. Did you mean {suggestion}?
config_resolve_failed: The configuration could not be resolved: {count} problem(s).
config_resolved: Configuration resolved: profile {profile}, {templates} active template(s), {fields} value(s).
config_builtin_broken: A built-in JGates item is invalid: {detail}
config_builtin_broken_fix: Reinstall JGates; if it persists, report the defect.
resolve_config_invalid_fix: Run jgates config validate to see each problem with file and field.
resolve_enabled_null_fix: To switch off use enabled: false; to inherit, remove the field.
resolve_list_op_not_list: List operation (add, remove or replace) at {pointer}, which is not a list.
resolve_list_op_add_remove: The item {item} is in both add and remove of {pointer}.
resolve_remove_missing: remove of {item} at {pointer}: the item is not in the inherited list.
resolve_template_unknown: The built-in template '{ref}' does not exist.
resolve_template_outside: The template '{ref}' points outside the project.
resolve_template_missing: The template file '{ref}' does not exist.
resolve_template_invalid_fix: Fix the template file; the format is in schemas/config/template.schema.json.
resolve_template_entry_unknown: The template '{id}' is not declared in templates of jgates.yml.
resolve_template_conflict: The templates {a} and {b} define {pointer} with different values and nothing defines which one wins.
resolve_template_conflict_fix: Declare priority in the templates in jgates.yml (the highest wins) or make one extend the other; file order never decides.
resolve_cycle_fix: Remove one of the extends in the chain to break the cycle.
resolve_profile_duplicate: The profile '{id}' is defined in {a} and in {b}.
config_option_skip: Switches selectors off for this run only (separate several with commas).
